scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Why don't you come back after becoming stronger?
Maybe, level 130.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
等你變強了再來吧。
也許，130級的時候。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
A long time ago, this castle did not look like this.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
很久以前，這座城堡並不是現在這個樣子。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Ah, I'm sorry. I'm muttering in front of a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
啊，抱歉。我在陌生人面前自言自語了。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
My name is Hugin. I'm studying the dimensional gap between time and space.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我叫胡金。我正在研究時間與空間之間的次元裂縫。

scripts.text: There's something like that here?
scripts.translation: 這裡也有那樣的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have you ever wondered about the history of Glast Heim?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你有沒有想過葛拉斯特海姆的歷史？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
There was a King named Shumiche who was known as a tyrant in the history of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
盧恩·米德加茲王國曆史上有一位名叫舒米切的國王，他被稱為暴君。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Time will reveal the true answers if we look in the right places.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
如果我們找對地方，時間會揭示真正的答案。

scripts.text: I don't care about history
scripts.translation: 我對歷史不感興趣

scripts.text: That is interesting. Did you find anything?
scripts.translation: 這很有趣。你發現了什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? Hmm, please come back later when you are interested then.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的嗎？嗯，等你感興趣的時候再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Actually, dimensional time travel is possible but I'm too afraid to go there.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
其實，維度時間旅行是可能的，但我太害怕了，不敢去。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
It might be possible for you!
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
也許你可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Do you want to time travel?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你想進行時間旅行嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Yes, of course I do!
scripts.translation: 當然想！

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? But, jumping gigawatts, this is such a great opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的嗎？天哪，這可是千載難逢的好機會。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
I knew that you would understand what I said. Well, please tell me what you want to do.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我就知道你會理解我的意思。那麼，請告訴我你想做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Umm? Did you see me at another place? I don't think so. What about this time?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
嗯？你在別的地方見過我嗎？我不覺得。那這次呢？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Why don't you make a party with more than 1 person and talk to me again?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你為什麼不組建一個超過1人的隊伍，然後再來找我呢？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
After the time gap opens, please tell me again.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？
[胡金]
時間裂隙開啟後，請再告訴我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？
[胡金]
發生了未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
The time gap is not yet open.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？
[胡金]
時間裂隙尚未開啟。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
Your body is not fit to enter the time gap. You won't be able to get in if you're not in a party.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？
[胡金]
你的身體狀態不適合進入時間裂隙。如果沒有加入隊伍，你將無法進入。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?
[Hugin]
Oh, my...
You still have after-effects of time travel. You can't travel again with this condition.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
我們以前見過嗎？不可能。這是我第一次見到你。你想做什麼？
[胡金]
哎呀...
你身上還殘留著時間旅行的後遺症。在這種狀態下，你無法再次進行旅行。

scripts.text: Enter Old Glast Heim
scripts.translation: 進入舊葛拉斯特海姆

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
After the time gap opens, please tell me again.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
時間裂隙開啟後，請再告訴我一次。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
發生了未知錯誤。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
The time gap is not yet open.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
時間裂隙尚未開啟。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Your body is not fit to enter the time gap. You won't be able to get in if you're not in a party.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你的身體狀態不適合進入時間裂隙。如果沒有加入隊伍，你將無法進入。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Oh, my...
You still have after-effects of time travel. You can't travel again with this condition.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
哎呀...
你身上還殘留著時間旅行的後遺症。在這種狀態下，你無法再次進行旅行。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Staying healthy is important, so please take a break and come back again later.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
保持健康很重要，請休息一下，稍後再來。

scripts.text: ^0000ffAll traces of access to Old Glast Heim have been removed. Now you can talk with Hugin again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff所有訪問舊葛拉斯特海姆的痕跡已被清除。現在你可以再次與胡金交談了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Where's your leader? I need his help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
你的首領在哪裡？我需要他的幫助。

scripts.text: You have a previous clear record. You can skip the scenario and proceed accordingly.
scripts.translation: 你有之前的通關記錄。你可以跳過劇情並相應地繼續。

scripts.text: Omit moderately.
scripts.translation: 適度跳過

scripts.text: Appreciate everything.
scripts.translation: 完整體驗

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I've seen you, {0}.
I'm sure I can trust you. Let's leave right away.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我見過你，{0}。
我相信我可以信任你。我們馬上出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Are you the one ^0000ffHerico^000000 sent to help me?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
你是^0000ff赫里科^000000派來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text: Oh. Well I...
scripts.translation: 哦，那個我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah yes, I am. Herico told me to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，是的。赫里科讓我來見你。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
We don't have much time. We must report to Sir Heinrich about Himelmez's invasion.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我們沒時間了。必須向海因裡希爵士報告希梅爾梅茲的入侵。

scripts.text: Himelmez...
scripts.translation: 希梅爾梅茲...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is Himelmez?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
希梅爾梅茲是誰？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Herico didn't tell you?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
赫里科沒告訴你嗎？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
She is the Ruler of Death, Dead man's Valkyrie. Himelmez is looking to take the heart of Ymir from us.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
她是死亡統治者，亡者的瓦爾基里。希梅爾梅茲正想奪走我們的尤彌爾之心。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
She might even destroy this whole castle if she wanted to.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
如果她想的話，甚至能摧毀整座城堡。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Hurry! Report to Sir. Heinrich about Himelmez. I must check the defense barrier here!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
快！去海因裡希爵士那裡報告希梅爾梅茲的事。我得去檢查這裡的防禦結界！

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
My work shift will be over soon, but the next crew is not coming.
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
我的班快結束了，但下一班的人還沒來。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Something you want to tell me?
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
有什麼事要告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
Are you with Varmundt? Commander is waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[白騎士]
你是瓦爾蒙特的人嗎？指揮官在等你。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
I had a weird dream last night. My mom was in it... Wonder if she is ok...
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
昨晚我做了個奇怪的夢，媽媽也在夢裡...不知道她是否安好...

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
Please do not make a mess here.
scripts.translation:
[白騎士]
請不要在這裡搞得一團糟。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Orders please.
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
請下達命令。

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
How do you know Varmundt? I heard that he's not really a friendly man...
scripts.translation:
[白騎士]
你認識瓦爾蒙特？我聽說他並不是個友善的人...

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Doesn't this castle seem weird all of a sudden? Something's not quite right.
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
這座城堡突然變得很奇怪，總覺得哪裡不對勁。

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
I do not like to chat during work.
scripts.translation:
[白騎士]
我不喜歡在工作時閒聊。

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
...
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
...

scripts.text:
[White Knight]
What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[白騎士]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Khalitzburg Knightage]
Is there something you need?
scripts.translation:
[卡利茲堡騎士團]
您有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Where is your leader? I must talk to him.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你們的首領在哪裡？我必須和他談談。

scripts.text: Heinrich, you are in the castle now...
scripts.translation: 海因裡希，你現在在城堡裡...

scripts.text: Sir Heinrich. Varmundt...
scripts.translation: 海因裡希大人。瓦爾蒙特...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sir Heinrich. Do you know what is happening in the castle now?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
海因裡希大人。您知道城堡裡現在正在發生什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Aren't you the adventurer that came along with Varmundt?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你難道不是和瓦爾蒙特一起來的冒險者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
What is it? Something wrong with the castle?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
怎麼了？城堡出什麼事了？

scripts.text: Himelmez's invasion...
scripts.translation: 希梅爾梅茲的入侵...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dead man's Valkyrie, Himelmez is coming to take the Ymir's Heart piece hidden inside this castle!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
亡者的瓦爾基里希梅爾梅茲正趕來奪取藏在這座城堡裡的依美樂心臟堆積物！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Haha. Funny. Do you really think that is possible?
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
哈哈。真可笑。你真的認為這有可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I'm not kidding, Sir Heinrich. If I'm correct, then she will be here very soon.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我沒有開玩笑，海因裡希大人。如果我沒猜錯，她很快就會到了。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
We must hide the heart piece in a safe place before Himelmez's attack starts!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我們必須在希梅爾梅茲發動攻擊前，把心臟堆積物藏到安全的地方！

scripts.text: Even if you don't believe me...
scripts.translation: 即使你不相信我...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I can't make you believe me, but there's no time to argue!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我無法讓你相信我，但現在沒時間爭論了！

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Thank you for the help. But we don't even have our king with us right now.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
謝謝你的幫助。但我們現在連國王都不在身邊。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
We cannot risk moving the heart just because some stranger says so.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
我們不能僅憑一個陌生人的話，就冒險移動心臟堆積物。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Save me, save me, please...
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
救救我，救救我，求求了...

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Save me! Save me!!!
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
救救我！救救我！！！

scripts.text: Hold on! Are you the only survivor?
scripts.translation: 等一下！你是唯一的倖存者嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hold on! Are you the only survivor?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等一下！你是唯一的倖存者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Chamberlains... monks... They all turned into monsters. I couldn't do anything.
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
侍從長...武僧...他們都變成了魔物。我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
All I could do was... Just hide in here... Nothing, nothing I could do...
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
我只能...躲在這裡...我什麼都做不了...

scripts.text: Pull it together!
scripts.translation: 振作起來！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Wake up kid! Go east and find the middle passage to the outside! It is safe there!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
醒醒，小孩！往東走，找到通往外面的中間通道！那裡很安全！

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
To the east passage? Alone? How?
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
去東邊的通道？一個人？怎麼過去？

scripts.text: I will give you a weapon.
scripts.translation: 我會給你一件武器。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here's a weapon. Just close your eye and swing for those monsters.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
給你一件武器。閉上眼睛，對著那些魔物揮砍吧。

scripts.text:
[Altar boy Domun]
Ok, I... I'll try.
scripts.translation:
[祭壇男孩 多蒙]
好，我...我會試試的。

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
You human?
scripts.translation:
[毀滅者 霍爾格倫]
你是人類？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
Die!! You shall die!!!
scripts.translation:
[毀滅者 霍爾格倫]
去死！！你必死無疑！！！

scripts.text: Relax! I'm not a monster!
scripts.translation: 冷靜點！我不是魔物！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Relax! I am Human. Are you alone? Is anyone else here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷靜點！我是人類。你一個人嗎？這裡還有別人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
It's only me.
scripts.translation:
[毀滅者 霍爾格倫]
只有我一個。

scripts.text: It's dangerous here...
scripts.translation: 這裡很危險...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's dangerous here. You know the way to the middle passage? Can you move?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡很危險。你知道去中間通道的路嗎？你能走動嗎？

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
Yes, I can move. I need to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[毀滅者 霍爾格倫]
是的，我能走。我必須離開這裡。

scripts.text: Be safe...
scripts.translation: 保重...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sorry, I can't go with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
抱歉，我不能和你一起去。

scripts.text:
[Holgren the Destroyer]
It's ok. You've already done enough. I can help myself. Good luck to you too.
scripts.translation:
[毀滅者 霍爾格倫]
沒關係。你已經做得夠多了，我能照顧好自己。也祝你一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Himelmez... I will never forget what you've done to my men.
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
希梅爾梅茲...我永遠不會忘記你對我的部下所做的一切。

scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您的物品種類或重量過多。請整理您的物品欄。^000000

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
I guess this is it. Is it impossible to stop the time traveler's will?!
A portal seems to have appeared to the north.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
看來就是這裡了。難道無法阻止那位時間旅行者的意志嗎？！
北方似乎出現了一個傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
This item has an extraordinary aura with it. Can be very useful for someone special.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
這件物品散發著非凡的氣息。對於某些特別的人來說，它可能非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
Don't look at me nervous like that. It will be over soon...
scripts.translation:
[希梅爾梅茲]
別用那種緊張的眼神看著我。很快就要結束了...

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt seems that you did not receive a reward for clearing the first floor. Talk to Varmundt and receive your reward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff您似乎沒有領取第一層的通關獎勵。請與瓦爾蒙特交談以領取獎勵。^000000

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
Himelmez's closed space covers everywhere...
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
希梅爾梅茲的封閉空間籠罩著四面八方...

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
How many times have I done this job? In my dream, I did it over and over again...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
我做過多少次這份工作？在我的夢裡，我一遍又一遍地重複著...

scripts.text:
[Heinrich]
What are you putting on Himelmez!
scripts.translation:
[海因裡希]
你在對希梅爾梅茲做什麼！

scripts.text:
[Varmundt]
Can't take off this bridle...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾蒙特]
摘不下來這個韁繩...

scripts.text:
[Gerhalt]
Uuuuu... Khhhah! Just run away with the commander.
scripts.translation:
[格哈特]
嗚...咳！快跟著指揮官逃跑吧。

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?
scripts.translation:
[希梅爾梅茲]
真了不起~你竟然一路走到了這裡。我可以道聲謝嗎？

scripts.text:
[Himelmez]
That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?
scripts.translation:
[希梅爾梅茲]
真了不起~你竟然一路走到了這裡。我可以道聲謝嗎？

scripts.text: ^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000您的物品種類或重量過多。請整理您的物品欄。^000000

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Hm, you are very well. First of all, let me give you some loot from Amdarais.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
嗯，你狀態很好。首先，讓我給你一些從暗答萊屍那裡搶來的戰利品。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Varmundt's time is stopped by me.
And your time will be distorted soon.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
瓦爾蒙特的時間被我停住了。
而你的時間很快就會發生扭曲。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Maybe this poor time traveler will try to stop Glast Heim's tragedy from happening.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
也許這位可憐的時間旅行者會試圖阻止葛拉斯特海姆的悲劇發生。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
However, we will never overlook his behavior now and forever...
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
然而，無論過去還是未來，我們都絕不會忽視他的行為...

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Now let me remove your memory. If you see me again it will be someone new.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
現在讓我抹去你的記憶。如果你再次見到我，那將是一個全新的人。

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Oops. I almost distorted the time gap. Come over here. We need to go out!
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
哎呀。我差點扭曲了時間縫隙。過來這邊。我們需要出去！

scripts.text: You were just with me...
scripts.translation: 你剛才還和我在一起...

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
What did you say just before?
Anyway, that is not important. The gap of time will be closed so we need to get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
你剛才說什麼來著？
總之，這不重要。時間縫隙即將關閉，我們必須離開這裡。

scripts.text: Let me look around more
scripts.translation: 讓我再四處看看

scripts.text: Please let me out
scripts.translation: 請讓我出去

scripts.text:
[Hugin]
Really? This place will be break down soon. Please look around quickly.
scripts.translation:
[胡金]
真的嗎？這個地方馬上就要崩塌了。請快點四處看看。

scripts.text: The crack looks suspicious but nothing more to check.
scripts.translation: 裂縫看起來很可疑，但沒有其他可疑之處。

scripts.text: The crack looks suspicious but nothing more to check.
